Hello everyone! This is Massanikos, I am looking to run the first ever (to my knowledge) Erene Olympic Games. Being that I am a Greek Inspired Nation, I think it is fitting. If you would like to participate in our games, reply to this message. 

[b]If you would like to host the games in your nation.[/b] I need to know the name of the City that will host the game. Your full national name, and information regarding the stability of your nation. Be prepared to write up a paragraph, at least, to explain why we should host it in your city. 

Please let me know if you have any questions. 

[sub] For simplicity, all nations will contend in all events. [/sub] [/quote]
[b]Nation: Second Khanate of Alaqar[/b]
We offer that the games be held in our capital city of Shiganuur.

Within our capital city lies centuries of history and old Alaqan architecture, as well as a bustling and thriving port to take in cruises from. Being the largest city in all of Alaqar and one of the largest cities in Shamat, we are confident in our capabilities to retain and house visitors. As for weather, Alaqar is located close to the Arctic Circle, however Shiganuur lies on a green patch surrounded by an arid environment which helps to prevent extreme temperatures or conditions this time of year. The coastal waters which surround the Shigan Peninsula should also help to keep temperatures mild. The capital city is also home to a bustling port which carries in several cruises a day, meaning that Shiganuur will have the capacity to accommodate for the Erenian games if chosen.

We believe that all of these factors combined  make our capital city a good hosting location for the Erenian games.

[b]NAERIM FRONTLINE REPORT [/b]
[Spoiler]
[i]Tue, 22 Dec 2026 16:00 - Northern Tirakan, RU-Occupied Ridge Sector[/i]

Snow had been falling since midnight, thick enough to mute the usual echo of artillery. The Renaissance Unions front, the line that their officers proudly called the iron backbone of Tirakan, sat cold and still beneath a low ceiling of clouds. The anti-air towers, tall black silhouettes packed with radar vanes, scanned the sky. Men smoked in dugouts. Spotlights swept empty slopes. Silence. 

Soon enough the ground began to vibrate. It wasnt artillery. Not tanks. Something deeper, from within. No. From beneath.
Some worried soldiers talking about earthquakes, the mountains were notorious for shallow tremors. But this one didnt fade. It grew. A continuous rolling vibration that seemed to come from beneath, but it just couldnt be an earthquake. Could it?

One of the officers ran to the edge of the ridge, lifting his binoculars toward the valleys below. He expected engines and headlights, but he saw nothing, even as the vibration grew louder.
By the time he lowered the binoculars, the snow beneath his boots cracked, and an entire sheet of ground fifty meters downslope collapsed inward.
But this should've been impossible. The large tunnels connecting the whole country have been destroyed. King Al-Tiran himself ordered his men to blow them up, in order to prevent invasions from below, right when the civil war began. How is this possible? Have the men missed out a part, which now collapsed into itself?

No.

There was a long silence, filled with the low humming of a few engines. It has been 30 minutes now, and no soldier has dared getting close to the rift. 
Sooner or later a cloud of dust burst upward as steel doors, long buried under rock, snapped open. Out of the ruptured slope, Naerim armored carriers surged forward in staggered formation, headlights off, engines grumbling as they tore through the broken crust of earth.

The officer barely had time to shout before the first impacts hit their trenches from behind.
Their impregnable line had been flanked. For years the underground railway tunnels have been seen as collapsed, flooded, rotted, they've been deemed irrelevant. But Naerims engineers had spent the past five years draining, reinforcing, and reconnecting them under the cover of storms and overground movements.

Now the tunnels opened like a mouth straight down to hell.
RU infantry scrambled out of their dugouts only to find Naerim soldiers already moving along their communication trenches.
Grenades rolled under sandbags.
Machine fire swept the switchback paths.
No warning. No time to reposition. Calling their outer defensive line to be fallen would've been an understatement. They've been obliterated.

Smoke rose in long vertical columns as Naerim drones, flying below the radar horizon of the RU anti-air grid, struck fuel dumps and supply shacks hidden in the forests behind the ridge. They knew where they were. Every single one of them. Naerim knew all along. The explosions came seconds apart, each one pushing shockwaves through the snow-choked trees.
Farther below in the valley, Naerim artillery opened up, not firing uphill as the RU generals originally would've expected, but sideways, targeting RU anti-air emplacements from an angle the operators could neither detect nor shield. Concrete bunkers cracked as the shells slammed through their exposed flanks.
One of the towers toppled like a burning mast, its radar dish folding in half as it plunged into the ravine.

There was no sign of holding back.

By the time RU reinforcements attempted to regroup and counter Naerim forces, the battlefield had changed shape entirely. Naerim mechanized infantry were already positioned behind their second defensive belt, cutting off escape routes and sealing supply roads.
For every Naerim soldier shot, two bullets fired back. 
Local RU commanders tried to order a fallback, but their lines of communication were being shredded whilst they've been recieving command from the higher-up. Burst transmissions. Half-sent coordinates. Static.
Two soldiers in RU winter jackets stumbled out of a trench, dropping their rifles, knelt and raised their hand. 

We surrender! We're no threat. Shot within the second they dropped their weapons. History will be written by the victor, after all.

The snow kept falling. It muffled the thump of collapsing fortifications.
An hour after the ground first shook, the outermost RU line was gone. They've sworn it was impregnable.
The eniges of Naerim APC's hummed steadily, climbing higher into territory they were never meant to reach.
And somewhere deep within that network of reclaimed tunnels, engineers were stabilizing the old system once again.

The war had just turned inside out.
[/spoiler]

[b]The THEP Summit | Erene 2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

[b][sub]-Official Notice of the calling of a THEP Summit[/sub][/b]

From: Secretariat of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter

To the esteemed nation of the Thyven-Hydronian Economic Pact, on behalf of everyone in the Second Flouesch Republic, I hope this letter reaches my compatriots in your respective nations well.

 Given the current global situation, especially regarding the matters in Taiwan and the white sea. And given that the risk of escalation between our alliance and the Eleyserian Defense Union remains ever high. The Second Flouesch Republic would like to call a grand summit of all nations in THEP to determine the future of our common alliance on the world stage and in terms of our future relationship with the EDU. Preparations are already underway to ensure that our capital, Vëlvetel will be in a state presentable to the prestigious world leaders of THEP and its partner nations. The summit will last 4 days, and housing and food will be provided to you on behalf of the Republic.

Each day of the summit will cover a new topic:

Day 1: The Situation in the White Sea and the cooperation of THEP militaries, Diplomatic Global Approach 

Day 2: Cooperation of THEP military industrial complexes and inter-military integration, common military establishment, alliance military base sharing, intelligence sharing, and encrypted alliance communication systems.

Day 3: Inter THEP Civilian Cooperation space, mutual alliance-wide investments, education, mineral extraction, trade, and THEP expansion.

Day 4: A day for closing, and any other subject that member states wish to bring up

The summit will be held within the Palace of the Republic directly, using its international conference room. 

It is also upon our request that we use this summit as a springboard to accelerate fruitful cooperation between our militaries, and therefore, we also request that combined military exercises and joint training missions, involving our air forces, navies, armies, and all other military forces, be done in both the white sea and on the ground in Floueschia. We hope that these exercises will foster brotherhood and respect between our service men, who valiantly risk their lives to defend our common values of democracy, liberty, and the sovereignty of the nations. regardless of the victor of the exercises. 

Gentlemen, it is my personal belief that these measures are necessary. The only way we can defeat evil and tyranny, the very threats that pose themselves ready to strike our nations at a moment's notice, is by building a better world. A world safeguarded by those brave enough and courageous enough to defend it.

If you agree to the provisions of the military exercises and or parade, please forward the number of forces you will be sending to the Republic to my co-worker, Secretariat of Defense, Gonthier Fuelenger

Most sincerely, Secretariat of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter

[b]Preperations[/b]

The City of Vëlvetel had been quite literally rebuilt from the ground up after the Second Floueschian Revolution; much of the city's historic architecture and buildings had either been destroyed directly in the revolution or torn down for being too royalist. Vëlvetel's city center had been completely altered, what was once a massive reflecting pool that separated the various royalist buildings was now replaced with a lush urban park, of park. And additionally, a large road specifically meant for military parades on Republic Day had also been commissioned and completed infront of the Palace of the Republic. When the local council was informed that Vëlvetel would be hosting the THEP summit, they quickly got to work planning. Firstly, arranging the complete renting of a newly built hotel tower to be the residence in which world leaders would stay during the summit. The Stase would quickly swarm the hotel, installing new state-of-the-art security cameras, planning out hidden defenses, and a sniper's nest. Next, the local council would begin to hire the best cooks from across the country, and hire entirely new staff for the hotel, all personally vetted by the Stase beforehand. They would be critical in giving the best image of the city they could possibly give to the representatives of the various nations soon to be visiting. Celebrations would also be organized across the city, a bulletin advertising the military parade to the people of the city and impromptu seating for such an event would be set up. City workers would begin painting crosswalks, light posts, and other fixtures across the city in the THEP colors. 

While the local council of Vëlvetel rushed to organize its city, the Supreme Revolutionary Command was left with an entirely different problem. Mostly, the infrastructure and supply are needed to host various nations' militaries. They would begin to work on expanding various bases across the country, bringing in workers from the National Public Works Authority to do so. Extra rations would also be ordered, hopefully in time for THEP militaries to begin arriving in force. Meanwhile, advisory notices would be placed by the military on both the airspace and waters of the Republic, stating that military vessels and aircraft would soon be heavily operating within these areas. 

_______________________________

His arrival would be preceded however, by the arrival of five Thývenic fighter jets with pilots from each of the newly formed federal states.

[spoiler=[b]EMANCIPATION[/b]] 
[i]
Under the command of the Federal Defence Agency, RQ-80 surveillance drones began littering the skies of Valddera. Focusing on capturing and uplinking as much data as they could, the drones mainly observed top positions of Valdderan military installations, SAMs, and radars. This data was then uplinked to the Federal Air Command, which used the data to conduct their own SEAD operation against Valdderan radars.

Once dawn broke, a squadron of EA-18Gs arrived at the flashpoint. Utilizing their RF emission detection technology, the EA-18s quietly listened to Valdderan radio chatter. Receivers picked up fire control radars, pinpointing their bearing and type, which were then entered into the warcraft's database. Once locations were pinned, they were transferred to the guidance systems of the EA-18Gs' armaments. Once ready, HARM missiles were deployed, streaking across the Valdderan mainland. These missiles focused on blinding Valddera's radars and making way for the cavalry.

But this was not the end of the EA-18Gs' assault. Once HARM missiles were deployed, the squadron began a multi-domain jamming effort in tandem with other aircraft in the area. Utilizing its ALQ-218 receiver suites, the Growlers pinpointed military communication networks, target tracking, and missile guidance systems. This then made way for the Growlers' jamming pods, whose jamming beams were directed by the ALQ-99 suite. The Growlers now focused on disorienting and distracting Valdderan radio traffic. These beams were constant and relentless, aiming to overload Valdderan radars with deceptive radar signatures while also blinding others.

Once the initial phase of the assault concluded, the growlers made way for their aggressive counterparts. Squadrons of F-15s littered Valdderan airspace, focusing on achieving air superiority as quickly as possible. Theyd perform a sweep deep into Valdderan airspace, engaging enemy interceptors with the assistance of the growlers jamming efforts, while also isolating interceptors so they could be destroyed. The F-15s also focused on blocking Valdderan aerial reinforcements in contested airspace, dividing the airspace into flash zones that were subject to routine patrols.

Right behind the F-15Cs was the ground strike squadron, a band of F-15Es tasked with disabling Valdderas ground defense and aerial capabilities. Their first victims were Valdderan air defenses, mainly radar trucks, remaining SAMs, and logistical hubs. Using GBU-39B SDBs, the squadron initiated a direct payload deployment onto coastal air defense nodes. Meanwhile, another squadron spearheaded an assault toward internal airfields. Once within range, the squadron utilized precise JDAM bombs to bombard Valdderan airfields, focusing on cutting off Valdderan defense aerial networks and limiting supply.
Daesuns aerial assault had only one goal: destroy Valdderan aerial and ground resistance as quickly as possible and allow for further ground operations to take place.

In the Valdderan south, aerial assault brigades were fully mobilized and embarked. Their goal was simple: reach the Valdderan capital as soon as possible, seize it, and then install a new government. Therefore, close air support was crucial in keeping such an operation running.
[/i]
[/spoiler]

[b]December 24, 2026: Christmas Eve in Thýven[/b]

The joyous bells of Tharkønn cathedral rang out in echoing tones as the streets of the city filled with joyous families and workers, after a year of turmoil and chaos the city seemed to be experiencing normality for once. Though prices were still high, and unemployment struggling, the constant shifting of the government seemed over.
